shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'tsconfig.json' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,105p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'navigation|icons|uikit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && cat AGENTS.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html && curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/llms.txt -o /tmp/gravity-catalog.md && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Switch Modal Select TextArea ThemeProvider'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'brand|base-background|base-float|base-generic|base-positive|base-info|base-utility|text-secondary|border-radius|spacing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -160 && sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -a && npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@3 peerDependencies --json && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@3 @gravity-ui/icons@2 @bem-react/classname@1'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from \"node:fs\"; for (const [name,url] of [[\"icons\",\"https://gravity-ui.com/icons\"],[\"catalog\",\"https://gravity-ui.com/llms.txt\"]]) { const r=await fetch(url); fs.writeFileSync("'`/tmp/gravity-${name}.txt`,await r.text()); console.log(name,r.status); }'"' && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Switch Modal Select TextArea ThemeProvider"
/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md'

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Switch Modal Select TextArea ThemeProvider && rg -o '\"(House|Squares4|Folder|Gear|Magnifier|Plus|ArrowRight|ArrowUpRight|Bell|Sun|Moon|ChevronDown|Ellipsis|CircleCheck|Clock|Persons|ChartColumn|Layers|Rocket|Xmark|ArrowDownToLine|ListUl|LayoutHeaderCellsLarge)["'^"]*"'"' /tmp/gravity-icons.txt | sort -u | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextArea/TextArea.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from \"node:fs\"; const t=fs.readFileSync(\"/tmp/gravity-icons.txt\",\"utf8\"); console.log(t.slice(-1200)); for(const p of [\"navigation\",\"icons\"]) {const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("'`node_modules/@gravity-ui/${p}/package.json`)); console.log(p,j.version,j.style,j.peerDependencies);}'"' && rg -n -- '--gn-|--g-aside' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/*.css | head -60 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -125 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head -75 && rg -n -A 85 'interface (MenuItem|LogoProps|SubheaderMenuItem)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && rg -n -- '--gn-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader | head -45 && rg -n 'House|Squares4|Folder|Gear|Magnifier|Plus|ArrowRight|Bell|Sun|Moon|CircleCheck|Clock|Persons|Rocket|Xmark|ListUl' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -45 && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from \"node:fs\"; let t=fs.readFileSync(\"/tmp/gravity-icons.txt\",\"utf8\"); console.log([...new Set(t.match(/.{0,35}(house|squares-4|folder|gear|magnifier|arrow-right|circle-check|persons|rocket|moon|sun|list-ul).{0,35}/g))].slice(0,55).join(\"\\n\")); const r=await fetch(\"https://gravity-ui.com/llms/navigation/3/llms.txt\"); fs.writeFileSync(\"/tmp/nav-docs.md\",await r.text()); console.log(r.status);' && rg -n -C 3 'Required setup|styles|CSS API|--gn-aside|renderContent|subheaderItems' /tmp/nav-docs.md | head -135"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg '(css|scss)"'$'"' | head -20 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js | head -55 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.scss | head -140 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeaderContext.js | head -55 && rg -n 'as (House|Squares4|Gear|Magnifier|Plus|ArrowUpRight|Sun|Moon|Persons|Rocket|Xmark|ListUl|Layers|ChevronDown|Ellipsis|CircleQuestion|Palette|Globe|Smartphone|Calendar)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build && rg -n -o -- '--gn-[a-z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.js | sort -u | head -55 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeaderContext.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader/Item.d.ts 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from \"node:fs\";const dir=\"node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/\"; const t=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(x=>x.endsWith(\".js\")).map(x=>fs.readFileSync(dir+x,\"utf8\")).join(\"\\n\");console.log([...new Set(t.match(/--(?:gn|g)-[a-z-]+/g))].filter(x=>/aside|item|logo|menu/.test(x)).join(\"\\n\")); console.log(t.match(/.{0,80}size: 240.{0,100}/g));' && rg --files -uuu node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components | rg '/Item.*d.ts"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/CompositeBar/Item/Item.d.ts | head -120 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | sed -n '35,105p'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat index.html && git diff --stat && node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from \"node:fs\";const d=\"node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/\";for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d).filter(x=>x.endsWith(\".js\"))){const t=fs.readFileSync(d+f,\"utf8\");for(const term of [\"--gn-aside-header-min-width\",\"--gn-aside-header-size:\",\"function AsideHeader\",\"size =\", \"renderFooter\"]) {const i=t.indexOf(term);if(i>=0)console.log(term,t.slice(Math.max(0,i-130),i+300));}}'"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY' from pathlib import Path p=Path('src/App.tsx') s=p.read_text().replace('Моё пространство','{profile.workspace}') p.write_text(s) p=Path('index.html') s=p.read_text().replace('lang=\"en\"','lang=\"ru\"').replace('Gravity UI eval','\\n \\n Обзор · Орбита') p.write_text(s) PY npm run build && git status --short"
